id.description: The unique ID of the user.

name.description: The full name of the user.

email.description: The email address of the user.

bio.description: A short biography of the user.

avatar.description: The URL of the user's avatar image.

id.description: The unique ID of the post.

userId.description: The ID of the user who created the post.

userName.description: The name of the user who created the post.

userAvatar.description: The avatar URL of the user who created the post.

content.description: The text content of the post.

image.description: The URL of an image attached to the post.

voice.description: The URL of a voice recording attached to the post.

timestamp.description: The creation timestamp of the post.

likes.description: A list of user IDs who liked the post.

comments.description: A list of comments on the post.

id.description: The unique ID of the comment.

userId.description: The ID of the user who created the comment.

userName.description: The name of the user who created the comment.

content.description: The text content of the comment.

timestamp.description: The creation timestamp of the comment.

id.description: The unique ID of the message.

userId.description: The ID of the user who sent the message.

userName.description: The name of the user who sent the message.

content.description: The text content of the message.

image.description: The URL of an image attached to the message.

voice.description: The URL of a voice recording attached to the message.

timestamp.description: The creation timestamp of the message.

triggeredBy.description: The ID of the user who triggered this message (for AI responses).

userAvatar.description: The avatar URL of the user.

timestamp.description: The timestamp of the location update.
